issues.extracted: property tax 8,940,030 (remainder of Taxes 11,086,765 after Sales Tax fund)
issues.on_page: Taxes: General 2,502,807, Bond 379,812, TIF 6,057,411; SoA p2 Property 8,967,603
issues.issue: This assumes all General Fund taxes are property tax. A city General Fund often holds motor vehicle, occupation/franchise and other taxes, and the report doesn't print a breakdown of that column. It is also inconsistent with detail[0] and detail[16], where the same 'Taxes' lines are left as taxes (unlabeled). The line is marked computed/review.

issues.on_page: Licenses and permits 424,217 (budget schedule); 425,217 on governmental funds statement p4
issues.issue: The amount is recorded as printed, and the budget schedule's total 12,064,875 ties with 424,217. The report prints a figure 1,000 lower than the statement's General Fund (the only fund with licenses). It looks like a typo in the report, and it isn't noted in report_discrepancies or notes.

issues.on_page: Tax increment financing (5,998,844) under Other Financing Sources (Uses)
issues.issue: It is recorded as printed (other financing use), but the Statement of Activities (p2) reports it as a 5,998,844 expense. It is really TIF pass-through spending (economic development), and it is excluded from governmental disbursements. A person may want to decide how to treat it.

issues.on_page: Grant income 80,456 (SoA: operating grants, general services)
issues.issue: The grantor isn't stated, so the line could be state grants. It is already marked review.

issues.on_page: Grant Income 1,307,203 (non-operating; SoA shows it as capital grants and contributions for Utilities)
issues.issue: The grantor isn't stated. It is a capital grant, so it could arguably go to business_type.other_financing instead of receipts; it is kept as printed in non-operating revenues. It is already marked review.

The Nursing Home fund's expenses (depreciation 53,458, professional fees 829, and interest 61,431 inside interest expense) are categorized utilities, although the Nursing Home is not a utility. The amounts are small, and the line is marked review.
The label is annotated, not as printed.
